The '''Voon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Krenher sector/Legends|Krenher sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voon/Legends|Voon]].
